text:
luis: FYI PR #15821 is blocked from merge — macOS smoke shows a flaky failure only in CI, passes locally for me. buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/ci/builds/98765

anna: can you paste the failing log? I'll try a quick targeted rerun if it's legit.

luis: failing stack at render_tile -> asserts on pixel count. here's the tail:```
E AssertionError: expected 1024 != 1008
  File "tests/render/test_tile.py", line 42, in test_tile_render
    assert got_pixels == expected_pixels
```

chris: hmm that looks like nondet image output. we had a similar flake last month after the GL driver bump. @simon did we pin the mac image in CI?

simon: we didn't pin drivers; the mac-smoke job uses latest runner image. I can spin a targeted rerun on shard 3 now: `./scripts/ci rerun --build 98765 --shard mac-smoke-3`

ci-bot: ci-bot triggered targeted rerun: build 98765 shard mac-smoke-3 by simon (job 98765.3). status: queued.

maria: quick note — if the rerun flakes again we should avoid a snapshot update without root cause. last time we updated snapshots and downstream broke.

anna: agreed. if rerun passes, we should still run a local repro with `pytest tests/render/test_tile.py::test_tile_render -k mac --capture=no` and collect the image diffs.

luis: SGTM. @chris @maria can one of you give review approval once the rerun passes? I need 2nd approver to unblock merge window.

chris: happy to approve after rerun passes and diff looks legitimate.

maria: I'll hold off approving until we confirm it's not a flaky visual non-determinism. if rerun passes, I'll help run the image diff locally.

simon: rerun finished: ci-bot reports PASS for shard mac-smoke-3. but mac-smoke-1 still shows the failure (interesting). ci-bot: `mac-smoke-1: failed`, `mac-smoke-3: passed`.

anna: that split suggests a partial infra issue rather than code. can you paste the mac-smoke-1 log (job 98765.1)?

luis: pasted — mac-smoke-1 log shows same assert but different seed in renderer. snippet:```
seed: 48291
E AssertionError: expected 1024 != 1008
```

chris: if it's seed-dependent we should add test retry/allowlist for known nondets and file a bug to root cause. for now i'd prefer to wait for a clean run on all mac shards before approving.

maria: open a short ticket? I'll triage. marking `priority: P2 flaky-ci`.

luis: opened https://issues.redwood.ai/ISSUE-4312 — pinned logs and seeds. for merge timing: if all mac shards are green by EOD I'll request final approval. otherwise we'll hold until infra pinned or test guarded.

anna: thanks. ping me when issue updated; I'll run the local repro later today. :thumbsup:

chris: ack — will not approve until consistent green. if you want a temporary bypass we can request a merge exception from release lead, but prefer to avoid unless urgent.

simon: reassigning to eng-infra for runner image investigation. tagging @eng-infra.

luis: excellent. keeping this thread updated. thanks everyone.
